verdict.rationale: The Solo 2 firmware lives in a public GitHub repo (solokeys/solo2) with documented build, flash and debug toolchains, and Hacker keys can run self-built firmware. An independent community comment confirms it is 'open source firmware' rewritten in Rust. missing for 10: an explicitly cited open-source license, reproducible builds or any way to check that the signed shipped binary matches the public source, and any independent security audit.
